summary: DIMER from GPU/VASP peak image 04 with adjacent images 03 and 05 was selected as the primary VASP refinement strategy; the active-learning non-finetuning branch is production-exercised through calibrated strategy selection, while DIMER preparation and the model-update branch remain incomplete.

payload.objective: Prepare a hash-bound, reviewable DIMER refinement from image 04 for Fe(110) C*+H*->CH* without submitting it.
current_evidence: The calibrated GPU ML-NEB/ML-CI-NEB path has one strict internal peak at image 04 and passed geometry, periodic-mapping, and elementary-step review.
Exact SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP single-point energies on 03-04-05 preserve a strict local maximum at image 04.
The normalized 03-to-05 adjacent-image mode places 97.666 percent of its norm on zero-based C/H indices 45 and 46, dominated by H motion.
DIMER is selected first; a local ordinary micro-NEB is the fallback if DIMER fails, switches mechanism, or produces the wrong mode.
The active-learning non-finetuning pass branch has been exercised from complete GPU path generation through VASP labeling, exact force comparison, held-out calibration, and strategy selection.
The error-triggered fine-tuning/new-checkpoint/rerun branch is implemented but has not been production-exercised because the current checkpoint passed the force gates.
Only one checkpoint exists, so a three-member committee and calibrated model disagreement remain unavailable.
The current candidate path manifest is not yet finalized as an accepted DIMER parent; no current execution gate allows DIMER preparation or submission.
payload.one_executable_step: Finalize the checksum-bound GPU path as the accepted VASP-validated DIMER parent, assemble the exact 03-04-05 triad analysis, and generate the current PREPARE_DIMER_HANDOFF gate decision; prepare inputs for review without submission.
payload.submission_boundary: The strategy decision does not authorize DIMER submission. START_DIMER requires a separate current gate, reviewed MODECAR/input bundle, and explicit user authorization.
done_when: The accepted GPU path manifest binds the reviewed image tree and peak image 04.
The exact VASP 03-04-05 triad and calibrated-domain evidence pass the DIMER candidate hard gate.
A current execution decision allows PREPARE_DIMER_HANDOFF and the generated MODECAR/input bundle is ready for user review.
